conviction_note: Fundamental read is roughly in line (sell-side cutting Q1/Q2 but crowded record short, calls bid, stock at 12-year low and Nike's own Q1 guide of down low-to-mid single digits with slightly positive GM is already the consensus frame), so p_up is only 54 on an abs_move of 10.5 (implied 8.9, ex-06-23 median 6.4, max 15.5, slope understatement); the sign is a lean from positioning vs a sourced but fully public Q2-guide-cut risk.
bar: Q1 FY27 consensus about $0.43-0.44 EPS and $11.3bn revenue; two agreeing sources (CNBC preview per sweep row; TipRanks/Yahoo https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nke-ticks-higher-ahead-q1-080734899.html). Company guide: Q1 revenue down low-to-mid single digits, GM slightly positive (TheStreet/CNBC summaries of the 2026-06-30 call). Q2 consensus ~0.53 per UBS note, single source.
positioning_check: Short interest record ~87m shares, above 7% of float, up from under 3% a year ago (Yahoo/Benzinga-style preview, 2026-10-01); sweep snippet 85.7m at 2026-09-15 settlement, days to cover ~2.9 (MarketBeat snippet, unverified). Baseline skew_25d is -11.22 vol points (calls richer than puts, priced_direction_lean 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.75; options volume 1.6x normal with puts leading 8:7 (TipRanks). Short crowding plus upside-paid skew argues against a bearish sign.

findings.finding: Record short interest (~87m shares, >7% of float vs <3% a year ago) with the stock 52% off its high and 1.5% above its 52-week low, calls bid over puts by 11 vol points: a decent beat or a less-bad Q2 guide forces covering on a name where the max-historical reaction is +/-15%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline: +4.9% (2026-06-30 beat, Q4 FY26), +6.41% (2025-09-30), +15.19% (2025-06-26) on relief prints; -15.51% (2026-03-31) and -10.54% (2025-12-18) when guidance disappointed, so the reaction is guide-driven and squeezes have paid on relief.
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced in the upside-paid skew already; what would be visible if fully priced is a flat call skew and a stock already bouncing off the low, whereas spot is still within 1.5% of the 52-week low and 6% below its 20-day level.
findings.independence: Baseline skew (-11.22) and TipRanks put/call 0.64 on the Oct 2 expiry (https://www.tipranks.com/news/nike-stock-nke-set-for-near-9-move-after-q1-earnings-say-options-traders) agree on bullish option positioning; different from the sell-side cuts.

findings.finding: Sell-side pre-print cuts point to a soft Q2 FY27 guide: UBS (2026-09-17) models Q1 EPS 5c below consensus and a Q2 outlook of 31-43c vs consensus ~53c, Piper Sandler Q1 EPS $0.37 vs $0.43, BofA (2026-09-25) FY27 EPS $1.43 14% below consensus, Telsey Q1 constant-currency sales -3.8%; channel checks show US DTC down mid-single digits and elevated promotions, Dick's (Aug 26) and JD Sports flagged a promotional environment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide-driven selloffs: -15.51% (2026-03-31) and -10.54% (2025-12-18) on prints described as beats; the stock has not been paid for reported-quarter beats when the outlook was soft.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: the stock fell from about $51.76 after the Q4 print to about $35.9 and exited the S&P 100, so the cuts are in spot; only the gap between stale ~0.53 Q2 consensus and the cut estimates is a residual, which is why the size is small and net of the squeeze finding.
findings.independence: BofA downgrade to Underperform on 2026-09-25 (https://www.zerohedge.com/markets/moving-goalposts-bofa-downgrades-nike-slashes-target-turnaround-story-delayed) and Dick's guide cut (https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/26/dicks-sporting-goods-warning-bodes-poorly-for-nike/) point the same way; the sell-side items share one channel-check narrative so count as one read.
